title: Candidatus Sarmatiella mevalonica genome sequencing and assembly
description: The genome sequencing of the newly characterised bacterial endosymbiont Candidatus Sarmatiella mevalonica was carried out together with its host Paramecium tredecaurelia, in order to make investigations on their interaction and infer evolutionary trends for the bacterium in comparison with its relatives
samples: Microbe sample from Candidatus Sarmatiella mevalonica Rickettsiales bacterium associated with Paramecium tredecaurelia WO2
